## Summary

- **Real OAuth provider exchange** — `hh-mcp-lab/src/oauth.rs` is the
  GitHub OAuth-App device flow over the admitted `hh-tls`+`hh-wire`
  stack (device-code POST → `authorization_pending`/`slow_down`/
  `expired_token`/`access_denied`/`incorrect_device_code` polling with
  injected sleep → `GET /user` subject). `LabServer.oauth_issuers` is
  the declared issuer table: a declared `issuer_ref` verifies through
  the provider's subject endpoint; an undeclared issuer keeps the
  kernel `minted_scoped` leg (ADR-0351 D5 untouched). The access token
  is held broker-side, exchange-scope only — never ledgered; records
  carry `subject_login_sha256`.
- **mTLS peer-identity mediator** — `hh_mcp_lab::http::serve_http_mtls`
  terminates TLS via `ServerTls::requiring_client_auth` (blocking
  handshake on bounded deadlines → verified `PeerIdentity` → the
  declared `mtls_subjects` map, CN → SAN-URI → SAN-DNS) → the same
  multiplex arm as the plain listener. `transport_absent` remains only
  where TLS is not configured. No `hh-mcp-lab→hh-tls` edge — TLS types
  re-exported through `hh_embed::service` (the `MintedVerdict`
  precedent; ADR-0365 D3's consumer set literally unchanged).
- **Typed refusals, never a guess** — forged/expired bearer →
  `credential_invalid`; provider-unreachable → new additive
  `CredentialRefusal::IssuerUnreachable` (transient no-answer, distinct
  from `transport_absent`); unmapped peer → `no_grant`; missing or
  rogue-CA cert refused at the handshake. Every refusal answers `401`
  in-band, never a fabricated subject.
- **`oauth-device` leg executed — PASS** —
  `HH_OAUTH_PHASE=complete bash scripts/live-verify.sh oauth-device`
  (resumed staged leg, operator at the keyboard): verbatim leg output
  `OAUTH_SUBJECT_SHA256
  f86bcf8a94b44669449f41d4dc9e9607d37ef8ce37b227bf8ea13e41c5d45b65` /
  `OAUTH_SUBJECT_LEN 11` / `OAUTH_RESULT pass` (`test result: ok.
  1 passed; 0 failed; … finished in 217.29s`). Committed
  `hh-live-evidence/1` record
  `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-22-oauth-device.json` —
  `result: pass`, `recorded_at 2026-10-22T02:58:06Z`, `provided: yes`,
  USD 0; SPEND.jsonl rows appended. **Honest history:** two earlier
  authorization windows lapsed as recorded skips — the first `auto`
  run's poll elapsed unauthorized and died pre-record on a leg-wiring
  defect (trailing `[ -n $subj ] && …` under `set -euo pipefail` killed
  `cmd_run` before `emit_record`; repaired to an `if`), and the
  `complete` run's full 840 s window recorded `skipped(pending —
  operator did not authorize in window)` at 02:19:48Z — both stay in
  history as they were (f4cb6e3); the same-day pass record supersedes
  the skipped record's file and stands.
- **Hermetic batteries** — `crates/hh-mcp-lab/tests/r4_7a.rs` ×10 over a
  scripted loopback issuer + the committed test PKI: every device-flow
  branch (happy/slow_down/denied/expired/malformed), forged bearer →
  typed `401`, undeclared issuer → kernel leg, unreachable →
  `issuer_unreachable`; mTLS mapped subject → 200 over TLS,
  unmapped → in-band `401` `no_grant`, no cert + rogue CA → handshake
  refusal. Live cells `r4_7a_live.rs` ×2 (ADR-0363 gated).
